# SparrowX Technologies

> Independent sovereign cloud infrastructure, bare-metal & Intel Xeon Gold / AMD Ryzen 9 VPS & VDS hosting, managed PostgreSQL databases, autonomous eBPF/XDP DDoS defense, game server hosting, and zero-knowledge developer utilities.

## Core Platforms

- [SparrowX Platform Hub](https://sparrowx.net/): Unified overview, live system status, documentation, and Client Area.
- [SparrowX Cloud Infra](https://infra.sparrowx.net/): Dual Intel Xeon Gold & AMD Ryzen 9 9950X KVM VPS, Dedicated VDS, and Bare Metal servers in Mumbai, Singapore, Frankfurt, and Gravelines.
- [SparrowX Cloud DB](https://db.sparrowx.net/): Managed PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector Studio with PostgREST API and PgBouncer connection pooling.
- [SparrowX Shield](https://sec.sparrowx.net/): Autonomous Edge WAF, L7/L4 DDoS mitigation, origin IP cloaking, and SOC telemetry.
- [SparrowX NetSec Guard](https://netsec.sparrowx.net/): Linux firewall agent, WireGuard Guard tunnels, nftables/XDP automation, and live threat radar.
- [SparrowX Game Hosting](https://sparrowx.net/game): Low-latency Asia-IN NVMe game servers for FiveM, Minecraft, SA-MP, and Discord bots with Pterodactyl panel access.
- [SparrowX GameSec L4](https://gamesec.sparrowx.net/): Stateful UDP/RakNet/ENet packet scrubbing for multiplayer game networks.

## Free Zero-Knowledge Developer Utilities

- [SparrowX Drop](https://file.sparrowx.net/): Zero-disk encrypted ephemeral file transfer and cloud vault.
- [SparrowX Keys](https://password.sparrowx.net/): 100% client-side offline cryptographic password and key generator.
